steps.en: Driver notices near their due date are picked up for the electronic reminder
steps.id: Notice driver yang mendekati jatuh tempo dipilih untuk reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: The scheduled job is switched off in the repo settings, and this stage's due-date setting cannot be seen.
steps.why_id: Job terjadwalnya dimatikan di pengaturan repo, dan setelan jatuh tempo untuk stage ini tidak bisa dilihat.

steps.en: The driver's latest mobile and email are checked before the reminder
steps.id: Mobile dan email terbaru driver dicek sebelum reminder
steps.why_en: The refresh from the data source is switched off in all environments, so the saved number is used.
steps.why_id: Pengambilan ulang dari sumber data dimatikan di semua environment, jadi nomor tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Opted-out, passport or no-contact drivers are skipped and the letter continues
steps.id: Driver opt-out, passport atau tanpa kontak dilewati dan letter jalan terus

steps.en: Individual drivers get an SMS, company drivers an email
steps.id: Driver individu dapat SMS, driver perusahaan dapat email
steps.why_en: Company drivers get no email at this letter stage because the email text is skipped there.
steps.why_id: Driver perusahaan tidak dapat email di stage surat ini karena teks email dilewati.
